question: Which OpenClaw browser or gateway issue should own this Ubuntu managed-browser startup evidence, or should maintainers create a new canonical runtime report?
rationale: The affected implementation and validation environment are outside ClawHub, while the potentially related OpenClaw reports have materially different symptoms and cannot safely be treated as the same root cause.

options.title: Route after root-cause match
options.body: Confirm the closest OpenClaw managed-browser startup report and cross-link or transfer this detailed evidence there.

options.title: Create canonical runtime report
options.body: Create a new OpenClaw runtime issue if existing reports do not match the Chrome-launch and CDP-readiness failure.

options.title: Request current diagnostics first
options.body: Keep this issue as a temporary routing stub while requesting a current OpenClaw version, gateway logs, and direct Chrome launch output.

recommendation.title: Route after root-cause match
recommendation.body: Confirm the closest OpenClaw managed-browser startup report and cross-link or transfer this detailed evidence there.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed ClawHub scope and routing contact, although the browser-runtime implementation owner remains outside this checkout.
